plugin.hwp.open.description: The surface mounted for the file path; format is hwp or hwpx.

plugin.hwp.new.description: A tab without params.path opened a blank document of the editor; name is the file name that its first save proposes.

plugin.hwp.place.description: The answer of core.file.place at the first save of a blank document: path is the chosen file relative to the project root, or null when the person cancelled; error names a refused place.

plugin.hwp.close.description: The surface of the file path was disposed.

plugin.hwp.phase.description: The start reached a step: starting, reading, opening or ready.

plugin.hwp.read.description: One read of the file through the files sidecar; reason is start, reload or change, size is the number of bytes read, and error is <code>: <text> when ok is false.

plugin.hwp.render.description: The editor loaded the bytes of the file and drew its pages; pages is the page count it reported.

plugin.hwp.save.description: One save: the export of the editor and the write through the files sidecar; size is the number of bytes written; format is null when the place of a blank document has no hwp or hwpx extension.

plugin.hwp.watch.description: The request that watches the file on disk.

plugin.hwp.watch.failed.description: The files sidecar reported that the watch stopped.

plugin.hwp.disk.changed.description: The file changed on disk; action is reload when the editor holds no unsaved edits and banner when it does.

plugin.hwp.studio.message.description: A message of the editor page: listening, save, modified or selection.

plugin.hwp.studio.error.description: The editor page reported that it cannot read its state.

plugin.hwp.studio.save_failed.description: A save that the editor page started with Command-S failed; the tab shows the same failure.

plugin.hwp.request.description: One embed request to the editor page and its answer.

plugin.hwp.command.description: One run of a command of the surface: hwp.save, hwp.reload or hwp.request.
